metaDescription: Professional business card printing services by FBS Prints. Choose from standard, premium, matte, glossy, and custom finishes to make a lasting first impression.
intro: Make a memorable first impression with high-quality, custom-printed business cards designed to showcase your professional brand.
description: Your business card is more than just contact information-it is a physical extension of your brand. At FBS Prints, we combine high-resolution digital print technology with premium, heavy cardstocks to produce business cards that demand attention. Whether you are networking at local events, meeting with prospective clients, or distributing cards at your front desk, our prints offer sharp legibility and vibrant colors. We offer standard shapes, square designs, and custom configurations with options like rounded corners and premium finishes to fit your visual identity.
features: Premium cardstock options (14pt, 16pt, or extra-thick 18pt)
Standard, square, rounded corner, and custom sizes

faqs.question: What is the standard size of a business card?
faqs.answer: The standard size for a business card is 3.5 inches by 2 inches. We also offer square cards (2.5" x 2.5") and custom dimensions to fit your brand's style.

faqs.question: What is the difference between matte and glossy finishes?
faqs.answer: Matte finishes offer a smooth, non-reflective surface that is easy to write on and looks modern. Glossy (UV) finishes have a high-shine coating that makes colors pop and provides extra durability and resistance to scratches.

faqs.question: Can I print on both sides of my business card?
faqs.answer: Yes, we support double-sided printing. You can print your logo on the front and contact info, a QR code, social handles, or an appointment schedule on the back.

faqs.question: What are the most common folding options for brochures?
faqs.answer: The most popular fold is the Tri-Fold (folding into three panels), followed by the Bi-Fold (half-fold) and Z-Fold (folding back-and-forth like an accordion).

faqs.question: Can you design my brochure template?

FBS Prints offers top-tier apparel printing solutions including high-definition Direct-to-Garment (DTG) printing for detailed, multi-color designs, and traditional screen printing for durable, high-volume orders. features: Direct-to-Garment (DTG) for detailed, photo-realistic multi-color designs

faqs.question: What print method is best for custom T-shirts?
faqs.answer: For highly detailed or multi-color designs with low quantities, Direct-to-Garment (DTG) is best because it has no color setup limits. For simple designs and large bulk orders, screen printing is the most cost-effective and durable option.

faqs.question: Do you have a minimum order size for T-shirt printing?
faqs.answer: We accommodate orders of all sizes, from single custom shirts using DTG to bulk orders of 100+ shirts using screen printing.

faqs.question: How should I care for my printed T-shirt?
faqs.answer: To preserve the print's vibrancy and lifespan, wash the shirts inside out in cold water and tumble dry on low heat or hang dry. Avoid ironing directly on the printed design.

faqs.question: When is the best time to order promotional calendars?

faqs.answer: Yes. While the covers and photos are printed on gloss paper, the grid pages are finished to allow easy writing with standard pens and markers.

faqs.question: How should I hang my vinyl banner?
faqs.answer: Banners come with metal grommets placed every 2 to 3 feet along the edges. You can secure the banner using zip ties, bungee cords, ropes, or mounting screws.

faqs.question: What is a mesh banner and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Mesh banners have small holes that let wind pass through. They are ideal for high-wind outdoor environments like fences, scaffolding, or open fields where a solid vinyl banner might tear.

faqs.question: Are the banners weather-resistant?
faqs.answer: Yes, our banners are made of waterproof vinyl and printed with UV-cured inks that resist fading, scratching, and water damage.

intro: Streamline your documentation with custom-printed carbonless (NCR) forms, perfect for invoices, receipts, and order slips.
description: For businesses that require physical signatures, immediate duplicate documentation, or hand-written records, custom carbonless (NCR) forms are a necessity. FBS Prints provides multi-part carbonless sets (2-part duplicate, 3-part triplicate, or 4-part quadruplicate) that cleanly transfer writing from the top sheet to the sheets beneath without messy carbon inserts. We print your company logo, layout, terms, and tables clearly, and offer optional sequential numbering for invoice, receipt, and work order tracking.
features: 2-Part (Duplicate), 3-Part (Triplicate), or 4-Part (NCR) sets
Custom branding with your logo, fields, terms, and conditions
Sequential numbering options for easy invoice and receipt tracking
Padded with chipboard backing or loose sheet configurations

specs.materials: NCR Paper (White, Canary Yellow, Pink, Goldenrod sequence)
specs.finishing: Edge gluing, chipboard backing, wrap-around cover booklets, numbering

faqs.question: What does NCR stand for?
faqs.answer: NCR stands for 'No Carbon Required'. It refers to chemically treated paper sheets that transfer pressure from a pen to subsequent sheets, duplicating the writing below without messy carbon paper inserts.

faqs.question: What are the common color sequences for carbonless forms?
faqs.answer: For a 2-part form, it is White (top) and Canary Yellow (bottom). For a 3-part form, it is White (top), Canary Yellow (middle), and Pink (bottom).

faqs.question: Can I get my forms bound in booklet style?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer padded NCR forms bound in booklets of 50 or 100 sheets with a wrap-around cardstock cover to prevent write-through on subsequent sets.

faqs.question: What is the difference between standard and gallery wrap?
faqs.answer: Standard wrap canvas uses 0.75-inch wood frames and is suitable if you want to insert the canvas into a decorative outer frame. Gallery wrap uses 1.5-inch wood frames, making it stand out further from the wall for a modern, self-supported style.

faqs.question: How do I care for my canvas print?
faqs.answer: Keep the canvas out of direct sunlight and high-humidity areas. To clean, gently dust it with a dry micro-fiber cloth. Do not use wet cloths or household liquid cleaners.

faqs.question: What edge options do I have for canvas printing?
faqs.answer: We offer 'Image Wrap' (stretching the edges of your image around the sides), 'Mirror Wrap' (mirroring the edge pixels so no critical detail is lost), or 'Color Wrap' (solid black, white, or custom color borders).
